title: Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs — Tracking and Borrower Notice Timetable
content:
The tracking and placement terms of the **Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs** are the same for all six tiers (Residential Mandatory Amount, Residential Gap, Residential Replacement Cost, Manufactured Home, Commercial Building, Commercial Building and Contents).

| Term | Meaning | Value on every tier |
|---|---|---|
| Tracking | Whether flood tracking and borrower notices are performed by Tidemark on the lender's behalf | Yes |
| Borrower notice period | Days after the borrower notice is mailed before coverage may be placed when the borrower has not shown adequate coverage | 45 calendar days |
| Reminder notice | Days before the earliest placement date the reminder notice is mailed under Tidemark's tracking schedule | 15 calendar days |
| Renewal notice | Days before a certificate expires that the borrower renewal notice is mailed | 45 calendar days |
| Lapse-date reporting window | Days after the borrower's coverage lapsed within which the lender's loan report lets the certificate start on the lapse date | 90 calendar days |
| Start on the lapse date | Whether a certificate may start on the lapse date rather than the placement date | Yes |
| Special Flood Hazard Area only | Whether certificates are placed only on buildings in a Special Flood Hazard Area per the Standard Flood Hazard Determination Form | Yes |
| Determination form | Form on which the lender's flood zone determination is made | FEMA Form 086-0-32 Standard Flood Hazard Determination Form |
| Determination review window | Days after the borrower is notified of the determination within which borrower and lender may jointly ask FEMA for a Letter of Determination Review | 45 calendar days |
| Certificates per loan | Certificates that may be in force on one loan and building at a time | 1 |

## Reading the timetable
- The borrower notice period and the renewal notice period are both 45 calendar days but run from different events: the first from the mailing of the borrower notice, the second backwards from a certificate's expiration date.
- The reminder notice is timed from the earliest placement date, 15 calendar days before it.
- The lapse-date reporting window of 90 calendar days is measured from the date the borrower's coverage lapsed.
